scripts.test:behavior:oracle: bun --no-env-file test tooling/acceptance/provider.test.ts tooling/acceptance/oracle.test.ts tooling/acceptance/artifact-evidence.test.ts tooling/acceptance/held-oracle.test.ts tooling/acceptance/artifact-cancellation.test.ts tooling/acceptance/qualification.test.ts
